displayName: CA013 - Protect security information registration

sourceFields.displayName: CA013 - Protect security information registration
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Requires combined registration. Confirm Temporary Access Pass enrollment/bootstrap, trusted locations and guest scope; test Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO registration.

displayName: CA014 - Require MFA for device registration

sourceFields.displayName: CA014 - Require MFA for device registration
sourceFields.Special target / user action: User action: Register or join devices
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Check device-registration MFA setting. Before CA enforcement, tenant Devices setting 'Require MFA to register or join devices' must be No. Validate enrollment journeys.

displayName: CA015 - Require MFA for medium-risk sign-ins

sourceFields.displayName: CA015 - Require MFA for medium-risk sign-ins
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: P2 / Identity Protection. Target MEDIUM risk only: CA008 already blocks HIGH sign-in risk. Validate registered methods and expected report-only behavior.

displayName: CA017 - Require compliant devices for sensitive applications

sourceFields.displayName: CA017 - Require compliant devices for sensitive applications
sourceFields.grantControls: Require device to be marked compliant
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: P1 plus device-compliance infrastructure (typically Intune). Configure target group IDs and app IDs; assess BYOD, guests and support scenarios.

displayName: CA018 - Require app protection policy for mobile access

sourceFields.displayName: CA018 - Require app protection policy for mobile access
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Requires Intune app protection policies, user targeting and supported client apps. Review unmanaged vs MDM-managed devices and verify mobile application support.

displayName: CA019 - Apply unmanaged-device session restrictions

sourceFields.displayName: CA019 - Apply unmanaged-device session restrictions
sourceFields.License Tier: Entra ID P1 + supported M365 apps
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Configure limited-access settings in supported apps (SharePoint Online, OneDrive, Exchange Online). Session control is not a standalone unmanaged-device block.

displayName: CA020 - Require phishing-resistant MFA for critical apps

sourceFields.displayName: CA020 - Require phishing-resistant MFA for critical apps
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: P1 CA. Configure sensitive app IDs and user scope; validate FIDO2/passkeys, CBA or Windows Hello for Business readiness and external identities.

displayName: CA021 - Restrict workload identities by trusted locations

sourceFields.displayName: CA021 - Restrict workload identities by trusted locations
sourceFields.Special target / user action: Workload identity: selected single-tenant service principal IDs; NOT agents
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Requires Workload Identities Premium (P2 does not include it). Target supported single-tenant service principals; managed identities excluded. User break-glass exclusions do NOT apply. Service principal risk is a separate possible control.

displayName: CA022 - Block access for elevated insider risk

sourceFields.displayName: CA022 - Block access for elevated insider risk
sourceFields.Prerequisites / implementation notes: Requires enabled Microsoft Purview Adaptive Protection/Insider Risk signals and appropriate licensing. Review external identity exclusions and privacy/governance obligations.
